title: GA PSC Order — Docket 40167 (Letter Order)
text:
LETTER ORDER

DOCKET NO. 40167

July 7, 2026

Sharon Warren
InteleTel, LLC
1501 35th Avenue, W
Spencer, IA 51301

IN RE: Cancellation of Certificate of Authority to Provide Competitive Local
Exchange Services (CLEC).

Dear Sharon Warren:

At its July 7, 2026 Administrative Session, the Georgia Public Service Commission (the “Commission”) granted the Company's request to cancel certificate of authority number L-0552 and to withdraw the tariff of InteleTel, LLC to provide competitive local exchange services in Georgia.

The above by action of the Commission in Administrative Session on July 7, 2026.

_________________________________ _______________________________
Sallie Tanner Jason Shaw
Executive Secretary Chairman

DATE: ___________________________ DATE: __________________________
